general.title: Shenzhen conquered tech, now it wants culture
general.summary: Shenzhen grew rich manufacturing electric cars, drones, and smartphones. Now China’s tech capital is spending billions on building a cultural scene. Backed by tech billionaires like Tencent’s Pony Ma, the city is racing to reinvent itself as a global cultural hub. (Source: Bloomberg)

general.title: Codelco Offers Lower Copper Premiums to Revive Sales to China
general.summary: Chile’s state-owned miner Codelco is offering more favorable and flexible commercial terms to Chinese copper buyers as it seeks to rebalance its sales book back toward Asia after selling huge volumes to the US this year.
